# /script-analyze

## Purpose

Turn a screenplay into structured production data: a normalized script, a
scene index with sluglines and page ranges, beat segmentation per scene, and a
first-pass inventory of every character, location, and prop the script
implies. Everything downstream — bibles, breakdowns, shots — is built on this
analysis, so it must be exhaustive rather than clever.

## Use When

- A script (Fountain, plain text, or PDF-extracted text) has just been added
  to `production/story/`.
- The script was rewritten and the scene/beat/entity inventory must be
  re-derived (existing scene files are diffed, not clobbered).
- You need a structural read — act turns, midpoint, escalation pattern —
  before committing to a story bible.

## Inputs

- `script` (path, required, default `production/story/script.fountain`): the
  screenplay to analyze.
- `depth` (string, optional, default `full`): `structure` (acts and scenes
  only) | `full` (beats and entities included).

## Invokes Agents

- screenwriter
- script-editor

## Required Skills

- script-analysis
- narrative-structure

## Process

1. Normalize the script to Fountain at `production/story/script.fountain`;
   flag formatting problems (missing sluglines, orphaned dialogue) instead of
   silently repairing story content.
2. screenwriter maps structure: acts, sequences, turning points, and the
   dramatic function of every scene — what changes, for whom, at what cost.
3. Segment each scene into beats (`BT_<scene>_##`): one beat per shift in
   intention, information, or power. Beats carry emotional value in/out.
4. Extract entities: speaking and non-speaking characters, locations with
   INT/EXT and time of day, plot-critical props, and implied wardrobe or
   state changes (blood, rain, injuries) that continuity will track.
5. script-editor audits the analysis against the text — every scene accounted
   for, no invented beats, entity names deduplicated and assigned stable IDs
   (`CHAR_*`, `LOC_*`, `PROP_*`).
6. Write scene stubs and the analysis report; list open story questions for
   `/story-bible` to resolve.

## Outputs

- `production/story/script.fountain` — normalized screenplay (Fountain, no schema).
- `production/story/script-analysis.md` — structure report and entity
  inventory (human document, no schema).
- `production/scenes/SC_###/scene.yaml` — one stub per scene with slugline,
  synopsis, beats, and entity references; validates against
  `schemas/scene.schema.json`, with each beat validating against
  `schemas/beat.schema.json`.

## Notes

- This command never rewrites the screenplay; story changes belong to the
  screenwriter working with you directly, then re-run the analysis.
- Entity IDs assigned here are permanent — `/character-bible`,
  `/location-bible`, and `/prop-bible` build on them.
- Run before `/story-bible` and `/scene-breakdown`; both refuse to run
  against an unanalyzed script.
